SMART MAPPING 
Precise map management allows you to map out your home individually. When cleaning for the first time, the robot automatically creates a map, which can then be adjusted as desired. ZONE CLEANING 
With the ZACOHome app you can divide your home into different zones that have different functions. Carpet zones, for example, are automatically cleaned with maximum suction power and purposefully left out when mopping. Do you want to clean the kitchen every day at 9am, but the living room only once a week? The timer function can be set according to your needs for each room, map or to-go zone individually by day and time. 

NO-GO ZONES 
Protect fragile objects simply with the help of No-Go-Zones. The ZACO robot specifically omits these on its cleaning trip. You can save up to 10 different no-go zones. 

SIDE BRUSH SPEED 
The speed of the side brushes is infinitely variable, which means that even coarse dirt can be picked up without any problems. This way, with the low side brush speed, no more cat litter or dry food will fly around your home. 

ADJUSTABLE CLEANING 
The suction power can be infinitely adjusted. REALTIME MAP VIEW 
Thanks to the real-time map view, you can always keep an eye on the progress of the cleaning even when you're on the move. Even after cleaning, the robot's routes can be tracked in the cleaning history. 

REMOTE CONTROL AND MODES 
Of course, the robot can also be controlled manually using the remote control function. This way you can navigate the ZACO to exactly where you want it to go, even when you're on the go. Cleaning modes such as circulating spot mode as well as edge cleaning can be activated here. 

SOFTWARE UPDATES
